Q01.entry: Next observed daily open after first completed five-bar gate
Q01.stop: Fifth gate bar low/high; skip if next open is already beyond stop
Q01.exit: Fast SMA reversal at next open, or intraday fixed stop; gap uses worse open
Q01.rearm: Gate must become false before a new five-bar gate
Q01.sizing: Integer proxy units, stop-based risk capped by gross notional; not NSE lots
Q01.end_of_window: Liquidate at final close, explicitly tagged window_end
Q01.costs: Declared proxy fee/slippage stress assumptions, not certified broker tax rates
Q01.overnight: Daily proxy can hold overnight; options translation requires separate policy
Q01.options_translation: UNIMPLEMENTED; exact contract, dated metadata and executable quotes required
